body: May dignity angle dito beyond the ¥ amount. The policy treats childcare months as contribution-paid months, so support is not framed as 'you failed to contribute' but as a period society chooses to recognize without reducing future pension credit. That distinction matters psychologically: good social policy can help without making caregiving feel like economic non-participation. Pero tama si Ramon—dignity-friendly ang design only if eligible parents actually understand and access it; hidden benefits are compassionate mostly on paper.
